PropertyTaxJobProcessor._comment: PollIntervalSeconds: Frequency (in seconds) the worker polls for pending jobs. BatchSize: Number of properties processed and saved per database commit/batch.

PropertyTaxJobRecovery._comment: StuckJobThresholdMinutes: Minutes of inactivity before a running job is considered stuck. RecoveryCheckIntervalMinutes: Interval between scan runs. RunOnStartup: Whether to scan immediately when the worker service starts. ScheduledTimeOfDay: Time of day to activate scheduled jobs.
